quote: Su dieci voli programmati, sette arrivano a destinazione.

speaker: Carabinieri investigation (Poggioreale)
claim: Poggioreale investigations describe night flights, frequently changed launch sites such as terraces, boosted drones and cargo hung on transparent lines to reduce visibility.
quote: Si parla di voli eseguiti di notte, partenze da terrazzi o da zone vicine cambiate spesso, di droni potenziati capaci di volare più in alto del normale e utilizzo di carichi appesi con fili trasparenti o contenitori scuri.

speaker: Vincenzo Musacchio
claim: A mid-range drone costs a few hundred euros; losing one is negligible for the criminal organisation compared with the cargo value.
quote: Un drone di fascia media costa poche centinaia di euro; se è intercettato o cade, la perdita economica per l’organizzazione criminale è irrisoria rispetto al valore del carico consegnato

speaker: Emilio Fattorello
role: national councillor, OSAPP prison police union
claim: Organised crime keeps systematically using technology and over-the-wall throws to supply inmates with drugs and banned objects.
quote: la criminalità organizzata continui a sfruttare sistematicamente la tecnologia e i lanci dall'esterno per rifornire i detenuti di droga e oggetti vietati

speaker: Massimo Catalano
role: local secretary, Al.Si.P.Pe. prison police union
claim: Union says criminal use of drones against prisons is increasingly widespread and requires advanced technological tools.
quote: Occorre dotarsi di strumenti tecnologici all’avanguardia per far fronte a questo sempre più dilagante utilizzo dei droni da parte della criminalità

notes: union statement, not an agency
speaker: Sappe
role: prison police union, secretary general Donato Capece
claim: The Poggioreale case confirms the established phenomenon of illicit drone trafficking into prisons, aided by detainees' freedom of movement under the open custody regime.
quote: conferma tutte le ipotesi investigative circa l'ormai conclamato fenomeno di traffico illecito a mezzo droni

notes: union statement, not an agency
speaker: Uspp
role: prison police union, president Giuseppe Moretti
claim: A technological war is under way in which organised crime uses sophisticated aircraft to defeat prison security systems.
quote: che è in atto una guerra tecnologica con la criminalità organizzata determinata a superare i sistemi di sicurezza degli istituti penitenziari attraverso l'impiego di velivoli sofisticatissimi

speaker: Rustamas Liubajevas
claim: Drones are also used for smuggling across the Belarus border, though not on a mass scale like balloons; losing a drone costs smugglers money.
quote: Jei kalbėsime apie dronus, tai jie irgi yra naudojami kontrabandai, tik ne taip masiškai.

speaker: Rustamas Liubajevas
claim: After surveillance systems and a physical barrier were installed, smugglers switched to drones and balloons.
quote: tos priemonės iš tikrųjų apsunkino kontrabandininkams gabenimą per žalią sieną. Jie rado kitų būtų gabenti kontrabandą – dronais, oro balionais.

speaker: Dmitrijs Kaļins
role: head, Latvian Prison Administration (Ieslodzījuma vietu pārvalde)
claim: Drones are not the most popular way to deliver banned items to prisons; parcels, visits and throwing over the fence are more common.
quote: Tomēr vēlos uzsvērt, ka dronu izmantošana nav populārākais aizliegto priekšmetu piegādes veids. Biežāk tiek izmantoti sūtījumi, radinieku vai citu personu apmeklējumi, kā arī mēģinājumi pārmest aizliegtos priekšmetus pāri žogam

speaker: Māris Vitkovskis
role: head, Technical Support Division, State Police
claim: A high-flying small drone is almost impossible to identify without technical means in an urban setting.
quote: Ja viņš augstu lido, tad viņu bez kaut kādiem tehniskiem līdzekļiem identificēt ir gandrīz neiespējami.

speaker: Wim Saris
claim: Intercepting contraband is a cat-and-mouse game; prisons cannot be guaranteed contraband-free despite the anti-drone network.
quote: Het onderscheppen van contrabande is een kat-en-muisspel. Ik kan daarom helaas niet garanderen dat gevangenissen helemaal contrabande vrij worden.

speaker: Annelies Verlinden
claim: Drugs and phones are increasingly flown by drone to prisoners' cell windows, so traditional bars are no longer sufficient.
quote: De traditionele tralies volstaan niet langer, omdat drugs en gsm’s steeds vaker via drones tot bij het celraam van een gedetineerde worden gevlogen

notes: Journalist's paraphrase of the minister's account.
speaker: Annelies Verlinden
claim: A detainee only needs to reach an arm out of the window to take the package hanging under the drone.
quote: Een gedetineerde hoeft maar zijn arm naar buiten te steken om het pakje, dat onder de drone hangt, aan te nemen.

notes: University summary of a Volkskrant interview.
speaker: Esther van Ginneken
claim: Drones used to smuggle items to detainees are a growing problem in prisons.
quote: Drones die worden ingezet om spullen naar gedetineerde te smokkelen zijn een groeiend probleem in gevangenissen.

notes: Anecdotal staff account, not tied to a dated event.
speaker: Complexbeveiligers (prison officers), PI Ter Apel
claim: Night patrols at PI Ter Apel find drug and phone packages hidden in grass on the prison grounds after drone noise at night.
quote: Dan vinden we bijvoorbeeld een pakketje met drugs of mobiele telefoon. Verstopt in een graspol, zodat het niet opvalt.

notes: Found during a walk around the outer walls.
speaker: Complexbeveiligers (prison officers), PI Ter Apel
claim: Staff sometimes find contraband around the outer walls when the string attached to a drone breaks too early.
quote: Dan is het touwtje aan de drone iets te vroeg geknapt.

notes: Reported by NOS; Europol report itself not opened.
speaker: Europol
role: EU law enforcement agency (report on cocaine trafficking)
claim: Europol says drug criminals increasingly use drones, helium balloons and semi-submersibles to smuggle cocaine into Europe.
quote: Drugscriminelen maken steeds vaker gebruik van geavanceerde middelen zoals drones, heliumballonnen en speciaal voor de drugssmokkel gebouwde "semi-onderzeeërs", meldt Europol.

notes: Forecast. Reported by NOS; Europol report itself not opened.
speaker: Europol
role: EU law enforcement agency (report on cocaine trafficking)
claim: Europol expects drug transport to move towards unmanned submarines and expects increased use of drones and helium balloons.
quote: Europol verwacht dat het drugstransport zich in de toekomst steeds meer zal ontwikkelen in de richting van onbemande onderzeeërs en dat ook het gebruik van drones en heliumballonnen zal toenemen.

notes: Same prosecutor also stated drones are a growing problem for prison safety.
speaker: Officier van justitie (Openbaar Ministerie)
claim: The Dutch prosecution service says drones are a growing prison-safety problem and wants dropping phones into prisons by drone classed as a crime rather than a minor offence.
quote: Het OM wil dan ook dat het droppen van telefoons met drones in gevangenissen wordt gezien als misdrijf. Nu is dit een overtreding.

notes: Attribution to the agency is implicit (article voice after SBS data); balloons dominate the article's figures.
speaker: Lithuanian State Border Guard Service (as reported by ELTA/LRT)
claim: Stronger Lithuania-Belarus border protection made land smuggling much harder, so smugglers increasingly use the air route, balloons or drones.
quote: W ostatnich latach, w związku z wzmocnieniem ochrony granicy litewsko-białoruskiej, przemyt drogą lądową stał się znacznie trudniejszy. W rezultacie przemytnicy coraz częściej wykorzystują drogę powietrzną – balony lub drony.

speaker: HM Inspectorate of Prisons (HMIP)
role: prison inspectorate, report on HMP Garth
claim: Inmates at HMP Garth burned holes in plexiglass cell windows and used stolen broom handles to reach drone-delivered drug packages.
quote: Jeden ze sposobów polegał na wypalaniu dziur w oknach z pleksi w celach, aby umożliwić przechwycenie towaru. Inni skazani kradli miotły i szczotki, używając ich trzonków do sięgania po paczki z narkotykami dostarczane przez drony.

speaker: Charlie Taylor
claim: Finding an effective way to stop drones is key to limiting drug deliveries to cells.
quote: Charlie Taylor, główny inspektor, podkreślił, że kluczowe jest znalezienie skutecznego sposobu na zatrzymanie dronów, aby ograniczyć dostarczanie narkotyków do cel.

speaker: The Guardian (cited)
claim: Drone smuggling cases in England and Wales prisons rose tenfold compared with 2020.
quote: Z kolei The Guardian podaje, że liczba przypadków przemytu z użyciem dronów  wzrosła dziesięciokrotnie  w porównaniu z 2020 roku.

speaker: HM Chief Inspector of Prisons for England and Wales
claim: Drones are now a permanent feature of prison life and cannot be eliminated without signal-jamming technology.
quote: z raportu HM Chief Inspector of Prisons for England and Wales wynika, że  drony stały się „stałym elementem” życia więziennego , a ich pełne wyeliminowanie jest obecnie niemożliwe bez technologii zakłócających sygnał.

speaker: GI-TOC (cited)
claim: In Europe, especially the UK, drone incidents are growing exponentially, among the toughest challenges for prisons.
quote: W Europie – szczególnie w Wielkiej Brytanii – liczba incydentów z dronami zwiększa się w tempie wykładniczym, co według The Guardian stanowi  jedno z najpoważniejszych wyzwań dla systemu więziennictwa.

speaker: El País (cited), Spanish police
claim: Spanish police seized a large drone with about 7 hours' endurance and up to 150 kg payload used to move drugs between Morocco and southern Spain.
quote: hiszpańska policja przejęła dużego drona o autonomii około 7 godzin i udźwigu do 150 kg, wykorzystywanego do transportu narkotyków pomiędzy Marokiem a południową Hiszpanią.

speaker: Autoritatea Vamală Română
claim: Customs said two of 24 undocumented drones seized at Calafat were transport drones of the kind used in cigarette smuggling, each able to carry up to 80 kg.
quote: două dintre echipamente erau drone de transport, de felul celor utilizate la contrabanda cu țigări, fiecare putând căra până la 80 de kilograme.

speaker: Inspector General of the Border Police
claim: Smugglers have started using drones to bring cigarettes into Romania, so the Border Police needs aerial surveillance.
quote: Inspectorul general al Poliției de Frontieră susține că e nevoie de pază aeriană deaorece contrabandiștii au început și ei să folosească drone pentru introducerea țigărilor la noi în țară.

speaker: Dragica Rajković
role: Head of treatment department, long-term prison (UIKS)
claim: Prison staff have had cases where a consignment was brought by drone, i.e. a drone attempted to deliver phones.
quote: Imali smo i situacije kada dronovima donesu pošiljku, tj. dron pokuša da odradi unos telefona

speaker: Uprava za izvršenje krivičnih sankcija (UIKS)
claim: Drone sightings over the UIKS prison complex in the last two months exceed the number over the previous two years.
quote: Naglasili su da su u posljednja dva mjeseca policiji prijavili da je u 20 slučajave primijećen dron iznad prostora kompleksa UIKS-a, što je više nego u periodu unazad dvije godine.

notes: No drone event described; counter-measure context.
speaker: Government sources (via Cyprus News Agency)
claim: Cyprus tightened its law in February and installed an anti-drone system in prisons, while increasing checks against phones and drugs.
quote: Cezaevlerinde cep telefonu ve uyuşturucu kullanımına karşı denetimlerin artırıldığı, şubat ayında yasanın sertleştirildiği ve drone karşıtı sistem kurulduğu da bildirildi.

speaker: Spanish police
claim: Drones used by the smuggling group were produced by small manufacturers in Ukraine and brought to Spain by road.
quote: Ifølge politiet ble dronene produsert av småprodusenter i Ukraina og fraktet til Spania via landeveien.

speaker: Spanish police
claim: Customers of the dismantled drone-building gang included criminal groups in Denmark, France, Italy and Spain.
quote: Den optrevlede bandes kunder omfattede kriminelle bander i Danmark, Frankrig, Italien og Spanien, oplyser det spanske politi.

speaker: Metropolitan Police
claim: Investigators assess that the drone gang was behind most of the drone flights dropping illegal packages into London prisons.
quote: Ifølge Metropolitan Police vurderer efterforskerne, at dronebanden stod bag størstedelen af de droneflyvninger, hvor ulovlige pakker er blevet dumpet ned i fængslerne i London.
